entries.title: Original song and phrase ownership

inputs.purpose: The exact original song and independently measured word timing.

entries.outputIntent: Preserve the original performance while planning visual coverage.
guidance: Keep the original song once at timeline zero; mute provider song audio so generated clips cannot double or replace it.
Choose performance segments at real phrase boundaries. A voice has one visible mouth owner within the phrase, and the performer and vocal timing remain explicit.
Use separately approved additional audio only for a declared role; a timing input is conditioning, not permission to replace the song.
verifyCriteria: Every performed phrase names its singer, audible voice and measured words.
Original-song mixing and any additional audio layers are explicit.
incompatibilities: Invented lyric timing, an anonymous singing mouth, or provider music replacing the track.

entries.title: Musical and visual development

inputs.purpose: Measured song sections and their musical function.
The approved story, motifs and selected visual approach.

entries.outputIntent: Give each musical section an intentional visual function.
guidance: Declare what remains constant and what changes in camera, state, light, performance or guidance.
Relate imagery to the lyrics explicitly: literal, metaphorical, contrapuntal or intentionally unused.
Use actual musical intervals and shot placements; a shot crossing a section boundary may serve both sections without becoming a second shot identity.
verifyCriteria: Every planned musical section has a visual function and change explanation.
Motifs and setup references refer to the actual approved plan.
incompatibilities: A copied chorus label standing in for a visual arc, or duplicate shot identities per musical section.

entries.title: Performance and spatial coverage

inputs.purpose: Dance, concert, instrument or staged-vocal intent and required coverage roles.
The actual location, performer references and verified camera/blocking geometry.

entries.outputIntent: Plan readable performance coverage and prove it in the final cut.
guidance: Dance roles requiring the full body also preserve floor contact; instrument roles preserve the instrument, hands and orientation.
Declare the minimum continuous performance interval, its actual shot references and assembly role before production.
Use native Clay views only for geometry, pose, camera and blocking. They do not establish final appearance, identity, lighting or style.
Record a deliberate exception explicitly; do not silently omit a required role.
verifyCriteria: Required coverage roles have concrete shots, performers and real reference demands or an explicit accepted exception.
The actual assembled selected clips prove the continuous interval; planning prose alone is not final delivery evidence.
incompatibilities: Neutral Clay passed as a look reference, unbound setup names, or cutaway fragments substituted for required continuous performance.

provenance.adaptation: Condensed existing music-performance, visual-arc, mixing and coverage semantics into reusable format-scoped craft context; project IDs and mutable project facts remain in canonical artifacts.
